codeCrossCheck.source: SPEC.md section 6, PD1; PD 6688-2:2011 section A.4 simplified method, Psi from Figure A.4 digitised by the author
codeCrossCheck.method: a = F'/M * phiMax^2 * K * Psi, with F' = F0*k*sqrt(1 + gamma*(N - 1)), phiMax = 1 (unit-max mode shape), K = 1.0 (single span)

expected.rule: Solver and simplified method agree within tolerance
